reason: I'd maybe download the free version, but paying for it, no. I don't want to hand my family's receipts and data to an app, and on $6,000 a year even $4 a month is something I'd skip when I already order from Talabat and don't plan.
objection: I don't trust an app with my family's data, and I don't plan ahead anyway, so scanning receipts every time feels like homework.
would_change_my_mind: Clear proof that my data stays private and isn't sold, plus receipt scanning that works with my Talabat or Noon orders automatically, so I don't have to do anything.
